name: Jenkins Health
author: H3nr1 D14z
description: Jenkins health in the Omarchy bar: live polling of controller, nodes (workspace and /tmp disk), queue, jobs, and updates; notifications for outages, node and disk changes, job failures, queue backlogs, maintenance; opt-in live disk probing of agents (usable space and volume totals, percentage thresholds); critical at a third or more agents down; safe actions (quiet-down, cancel queue item, state-checked node toggles) plus an opt-in per-node workspace wipe (admin token, per-job checks).

barWidget.description: Jenkins health monitor: status chip in the bar, detail panel on click. Middle-click refreshes.

schema.label: Jenkins URL
schema.description: Base URL of the Jenkins controller, e.g. https://ci.example.com

schema.label: API user
schema.description: Jenkins user id that owns the API token.

schema.label: Token file
schema.description: File holding the Jenkins API token. Created with chmod 600; the token is passed to curl via a netrc file, never as a process argument.

schema.label: Queue backlog threshold
schema.description: Waiting queue depth above which a backlog is flagged.

schema.label: Disk warn (GB free)
schema.description: Absolute floor: node free disk below this warns. On probed nodes the effective threshold is max(absolute, diskWarnPct x volume size).

schema.label: Disk critical (GB free)
schema.description: Absolute floor: node free disk below this is critical. On probed nodes the effective threshold is max(absolute, diskCriticalPct x volume size).

schema.label: Disk warn (% of volume)
schema.description: Percentage-of-volume warn threshold for probed nodes: warns below max(diskWarnGb, this % of the volume total). 0 disables the percentage and keeps the absolute GB only. Monitor-only (unprobed) nodes always use the absolute thresholds.

schema.label: Disk critical (% of volume)
schema.description: Percentage-of-volume critical threshold for probed nodes: critical below max(diskCriticalGb, this % of the volume total). 0 disables the percentage and keeps the absolute GB only.

schema.label: Response time warn (ms)
schema.description: Node response time above this warns.

schema.label: Failure penalty cap
schema.description: Max score points subtracted for failing jobs (0 = uncapped). Set when a large catalog carries a habitual red minority.

schema.label: Controller notifications
schema.description: Notify when the controller goes down or comes back up.

schema.label: Node notifications
schema.description: Notify when nodes go offline or come back.

schema.label: Failure notifications
schema.description: Notify on new job failures and recoveries.

schema.label: Queue notifications
schema.description: Notify when a queue backlog starts or clears.

schema.label: Maintenance notifications
schema.description: Notify on quiet-down, restart required, and plugin updates.

schema.label: Per-node workspace wipe
schema.description: Off by default. When On, nodes get a Clean ws button: it lists the job workspaces under the node's workspace root (folders walked recursively) and confirm-deletes the non-building ones via the Jenkins script console. Requires an admin-scoped API token; a job that is building anywhere is skipped, so one busy executor never blocks reclaiming an idle job's workspace. Works on monitor-disconnected agents with a live channel.

schema.label: Live disk probe
schema.description: Off by default. When On, nodes get a Check disk button plus a background fleet sweep every 5 minutes (wall-clock, first sweep 5 min after enabling): usable disk space measured live on each agent via the script console (requires an admin-scoped token), overriding the lazily-sampled monitor values; probed rows are marked with a trailing *.
